dec.pe: A Danish citizen born in Togo could not bring his wife from Ghana, while citizens by birth could. The Grand Chamber said the rule indirectly discriminated against naturalised citizens.
dec.pi: Seorang warga Denmark kelahiran Togo tidak bisa membawa istrinya dari Ghana, sementara warga sejak lahir bisa. Majelis Agung menyatakan aturan itu secara tidak langsung mendiskriminasi warga hasil naturalisasi.
